description: fix/imposed-drawbacks-grant-no-ap: the CONTROL for EV-025 — the same four drawbacks (Peg Leg 4, Lame 3, Old Wound 3, One-Eyed 4 = 14 AP) but PLAYER-TAKEN, each paying its table value as income (cost -4/-3/-3/-4). These ARE the player's picks and the player WAS paid, so both warnings must still fire: 'Drawbacks grant 14 AP — the guide caps them at 12 AP (check with your DM)' and '4 drawbacks chosen — most DMs cap this at 2–3'. Without this control EV-025's empty warning list could be a symptom of the warnings being broken for everyone rather than of imposed drawbacks being exempt.
